source: References and validity records reused only when full source SHA-256 matches; no measured Markdown output is used as a reference.

extractors.docx_pptx_xlsx: defusedxml over source OOXML parts; raw XML text/cached cell values
extractors.csv: csv.reader; utf-8-sig, gb18030, cp1252 decoding attempts
extractors.epub: HTMLParser over HTML/XHTML members sorted by file name

limits: References are text/structure proxies, not semantic or rendered gold labels.
PDF references and Into Markdown share PDFium; correlated extraction mistakes are possible.
OOXML XML order and EPUB file-name order do not guarantee visual reading order or spine order.
Raw cached spreadsheet values can differ from displayed formatting.
Some reference extractors cap accumulated character counts; quality scoring excludes Markdown outputs over 32 MiB.
privatePreservation: Full references are in benchmark-evidence.zip/oracles; original generator scripts are preserved in historical-benchmark-metadata.zip. Restricted reference text is not published.
